name: jats-publisher
description: Transform JATS XML to HTML and PDF

scripts.build:app: npm run build:standalone && npm run build:templates
scripts.deploy: sh -c 'TARGET=${1:-../../format-jats}; npm run build:app && rm -rf "$TARGET" && mkdir -p "$TARGET" && cp -R dist/* "$TARGET"/ && cp package.json package-lock.json "$TARGET"/ && npm install --omit=dev --prefix "$TARGET"' _
